title: Growth & coins
description: Every thoughtful practice counts. Complete small goals, collect coins, and choose a little reward of your own.
gentleGoal: Try 1–3 problems a day and practice on 3 days a week, at your own pace.
resetHint: Resets at midnight daily and every Monday, Beijing time. Today: {date}. Week starts: {week}.
checkinSuccess: Checked in! You can now claim today's check-in coins.
claimSuccess: Coins received. Keep learning at your own pace!
buySuccess: Redeemed! This item is yours permanently. Equip it to use it.
unequipSuccess: Default appearance restored. Your item stays in your inventory.
rules: Every account receives 100 welcome coins. Earn up to 50 coins daily and 100 extra from weekly tasks. New problems are problems you have never passed; references to the same source count once. Only normal submissions count, excluding test runs, data generation, and new passes from rejudging. A comeback requires a failed submission before your first pass. Task rewards stack and use the submission date. Claim within the current day or week; expired rewards cannot be claimed later. Missing a day never costs coins. Cosmetics are permanent and do not affect scores, rankings, or permissions.
contestHint: Contest and homework submissions count after the event ends and results are public, to protect hidden verdicts. They still use their original submission dates.
shopTitle: A little reward for your effort
shopHint: Select an item to preview before redeeming. Every item is permanent.
purchaseHint: Redeeming does not auto-equip. Switch items whenever you like.
shortfall: Save {coins} more coins by completing learning tasks.
ownedForever: Yours permanently. Equip or remove it anytime.
emptyInventory: Your inventory is empty. Clear the filter to find your first reward.
historyHint: Your latest 100 transactions. Total earned includes welcome coins.
